field_checks.summary: Reviewed primary XML/PDF body activity surfaces and final activity records: Fig. 3 text-supported survival values, Fig. 4b inhibition-zone labels, Fig. 4c MIC labels, Table S1 this-work MIC rows, and qualitative Fig. 4a/Fig. 6 exclusions are represented or documented with exact/approximate status.

All 12 DBAASP fallback/machine candidate rows were reviewed as candidate-only unresolved_record entries; linked authoritative article, assay, sequence, and literature rows are all zero, and authoritative_dbaasp_ingest_ready remains false. This preserves the release boundary but is not authoritative DBAASP ingest-ready.

Reviewed every current final JSON record. The five paper-final JSON files are byte-identical to the same packet-final mirrors; packet-final additionally has mechanism_evidence.json as a byte-identical alias of mechanism_ontology_record.json. Final counts are activity 24, toxicity 9, database audits 12, mechanism claims 6; live packet open rework tickets and strict acceptance status both report 0. No object in either final mirror contains both a plain one-letter sequence and sequence_length.

Mechanism ontology preserves evidence boundaries: SEM morphology and NPN uptake are direct membrane/surface mechanism claims; zeta-potential, self-assembly, CPFx intracellular/DNA-gyrase proposal, and MIC/growth phenotype are not promoted to direct mechanisms.

Primary paper identity was confirmed from XML as RSC Advances 2025, DOI 10.1039/d5ra02932e, PMID 40503297, PMCID PMC12153049. Entity linkage to peptide 1, peptide 2, CPFx-1, and CPFx-2 is source-backed, while exact one-letter sequences are not reported and are not fabricated.

Row-level activity/toxicity records mostly carry source locators and normalization status, but the final source_surface_coverage and worker6_core_contract_validation fields contain non-resolvable page-less S14-S17 supplement locators and conflate toxicity record IDs across LDH, body-weight, hemolysis, and organ-H&E surfaces.

No recursive-authority flag was found in current final records or the strict acceptance artifact. Fallback DBAASP machine rows remain excluded from RC2/portal/authoritative ingest, and authoritative_dbaasp_ingest_ready is false in both database and review outputs.

Current cautions are preserved rather than smoothed: no authoritative linked database rows, fallback machine rows candidate-only, and supplementary graph values approximate or documented as exclusions. No cross-database source_conflict record is asserted because no authoritative linked rows are present.

The staged supplement was independently inspected: one SI PDF with 19 extracted pages, Table S1 with 12 cell observations, S14-S17 with 160 quantitative figure observations, and zero extraction errors. The blocking issue is downstream final coverage mapping, not material extraction absence.

Toxicity/selectivity source rows are not publication-grade because the final coverage assertion misassigns S15 LDH, S16 body-weight, S17 hemolysis, and organ-H&E record IDs across the wrong supplement surfaces, while also reporting inflated S15/S16 coverage counts. This is a scientific field-level mapping error despite green gate output.

blocking_findings.reason: The final activity_toxicity_evidence.json cannot support publication-grade toxicity/selectivity coverage because source_surface_coverage and quality_checks.worker6_core_contract_validation.s14_s17_contract conflate supplement surfaces. The source shows S15 is LDH release, S16 is body-weight change, and S17 is hemolysis; however final source_surface_coverage lists body-weight records under S15, hemolysis records under S16, and organ-H&E under S17, and S14-S17 coverage locators omit page coordinates. This is a material field-level locator/count error, not an infrastructure failure.
required_actions: Rebuild activity_toxicity_evidence.json source_surface_coverage so each S14-S17 entry uses a page-qualified supplement locator and only lists toxicity_record_ids whose primary or supporting locator actually references that surface.
Recompute worker6_core_contract_validation.s14_s17_contract final_rows_with_surface_locator from the repaired row-to-surface mapping rather than from substring or stale coverage counts.
Keep approximate graph observations and documented exclusions, but bind them to the correct source surface: S14 BEAS-2B viability, S15 LDH release, S16 body weight, and S17 hemolysis.
acceptance_checks: A script over paper-final and packet-final activity_toxicity_evidence.json asserts no source_surface_coverage source_locator matches the page-less pattern supp:RA-015-D5RA02932E-s001.pdf:figure=*.
For S14, S15, S16, and S17, the same script computes toxicity_record_ids from row source_locator/supporting_locators and exactly matches the corresponding source_surface_coverage toxicity_record_ids.

The computed surface mappings are S14: PMC12153049-W2-TOX-001; S15: PMC12153049-W2-TOX-002; S16: PMC12153049-W2-TOX-007 and PMC12153049-W2-TOX-008; S17: PMC12153049-W2-TOX-003 through PMC12153049-W2-TOX-006, with organ-H&E kept under Fig. 6/xml:p:22 rather than S17.
Paper-final and packet-final activity_toxicity_evidence.json remain byte-identical after repair, and semantic/publication gates are rerun without allow flags.

cautions.summary: Authoritative DBAASP/merged linked row counts are zero; all 12 fallback rows remain unresolved_record and must stay excluded from RC2/portal/authoritative ingest.

S14-S17 graph observations are digitized approximate values or documented exclusions, not exact table values; this caution remains scientifically important even after the surface-mapping blocker is repaired.

Live rework state is closed with open count 0, but final review_report still carries historical runtime_open_ticket_ids inside ticket_contract_evidence; it should remain clearly historical to avoid being read as current open-ticket state.
